name: Magie blanche
notes: Sector with rather continuous, very vertical climbing.
Fairly shady at the base thanks to the trees.
routes: Complex to read. Climbing on dubious, really pumpy flakes; keep a bit in reserve for the finish. Sustained overall.
Very continuous up to the horizontal band. Economy and speed are good weapons for this route. A route with character. Very fun.
Difficulty concentrated at the start. Technical footwork. Reading is essential.
Very continuous route that needs a good analysis of the line. Often physical climbing that needs good management of the rests. A staple at the grade.
Really vertical climbing on jugs. A treat.
Continuous climbing with a hard move in the 2nd part. The summit wall is complex to decipher. Somewhat mixed route.
Very fun route on very sculpted rock. Athletic climbing on good holds.
Inconsistent but varied. Funny overhang with a nice cluster of holds.
Finishing variant of 233. Short but intense. An overhanging slab with crimps and a blocked crack on the menu.
Left finishing variant of 233. Athletic, with a nice variety of sometimes surprising holds.
The first pitch is short, on beautiful rock with plenty of vertical cracks. The second pitch is an airy traverse under a band of overhang, on rock that is sometimes a little polished.
A very beautiful route at the grade. Stunning atmosphere at the top with a great variety of moves.
Same profile as 235 with less obvious holds. Good lock-offs; a nice, really physical route.
Route through a small overhang, one very bouldery move. Lacks consistency.
Very nice, varied route that needs good pacing. Awkward positions give this route a unique character.
Slightly polished corner route. After the ledge, branch left; belay attentively because of the ledges.
Same start as route 239, then continue up the cracked slab straight above. Very beautiful.
